explication: 91 is a self-hosted private video library with a browser UI and Go server. The main user journey is browsing or searching the catalog, opening a video, and playing it; users can also browse an immersive shorts feed or open a one-time shared video. Administrators manage drives, crawlers, catalog metadata, backups, settings, and Telegram integration. The graph includes these documented capabilities, but implementation details for several backend subsystems are unsampled; their links are shown only where the README or indexed source references support them.
